scope: Direct MQTT actuator client creation and publish failures

behavior.client_creation: Client initialization errors log only the exception class and preserve the existing false result.
behavior.publish: Broker connection/publish errors log only the exception class and preserve the existing false result.
behavior.safety: Command construction, approval persistence, and dispatch decisions are unchanged.

coverage: secret-bearing MQTT client initialization error is redacted
secret-bearing broker connection failure is redacted

limitations: No MQTT broker or database was contacted.
This does not establish real actuator delivery or device acknowledgement.
